steps.description:
Everything hangs off this. It is published to the browser on boot, and the COVA Pre-Employment block on Job Offer only appears for offers of this company — pick the wrong one and those fields stay hidden everywhere.

It also scopes the registered-employee lists on the dashboard.
steps.label: Company
steps.title: 1. The company the scheme covers

steps.description: The root of the clinic's API, with no trailing slash — the endpoints below are appended to it. In production this is CheckUps; a Node-RED URL is the usual stand-in for testing, because it echoes back whatever it is sent.
steps.label: Base URL
steps.title: 2. Where COVA lives

steps.description: Sent as the X-Api-Key header on every outbound call. Leave it empty and the calls still go out, just unauthenticated — which is how a working integration quietly starts returning 401s.
steps.label: API Key
steps.title: 3. The key COVA issued you

steps.description: Appended to the base URL, e.g. /members/register. One endpoint serves both schemes: an employee goes as Active, a job candidate as PreEmployment.
steps.label: Register Endpoint
steps.title: 4. Register endpoint

steps.description: e.g. /members/deactivate. Called for leavers, and for the bulk sweep that catches anyone whose Employee status stopped being Active.
steps.label: Deactivation Endpoint
steps.title: 5. Deactivation endpoint

steps.description: e.g. /tests/request. Every medical test — pre-employment wellness, annual, cholinesterase, food handler, exit — is pushed through this one.
steps.label: Test Request Endpoint
steps.title: 6. Test request endpoint

steps.description: Only needed if COVA gives you a separate URL for candidates. Left empty, pre-employment registrations go to the ordinary register endpoint above, which is how CheckUps works today.
steps.label: Pre Employement Endpoint
steps.title: 7. Pre-employment endpoint (optional)

steps.description: Spare slot for a bearer token where COVA wants one alongside — or instead of — the API key.
steps.label: Access Token
steps.title: 8. Access token (optional)

steps.description:
Nothing in the integration works until this is filled in: every COVA call reads the base URL, the API key and the endpoint paths from here, and the Company decides which employees the integration considers its own.

Where you go next: open an Employee and use Clinic › Register to Cova. That creates a Cova Members record, which is the anchor every visit, request and result hangs off.

Press Save (Ctrl+S) to store the settings.
steps.label: Access Token
steps.title: 9. Everything else depends on this page
